title: Polypeptides that bound to IL-23 receptor and inhibit binding of IL-23 and cell signaling thereof
notes: MISATTRIBUTED IN DISCOVERY — assignee is MEDICAL DIAGNOSTIC LABORATORIES, LLC, NOT Protagonist. Reissue (app 15/727,360 filed 2017-10-06; reissued 2022-04-12) of US9169292 (lineage from 13/523,286 -> US8946150). Priority US provisional 61/520,710 (2011-06-14).
